QuestInfo.name: Entering Ulu City
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9270030##k seems even more anxious than usual. He's been mumbling about the city going down because of selfish people...
QuestInfo.2: You have completed first step to becoming the savior of Ulu City and proven yourself to be a brave adventurer. #b#p9270044##k will instruct you on what to do next.

0.0: Heeeeey, don't I know you? Yeah, you cleared out the #bGhost Ship#k. I hope you've been training hard, because I have, like, whoooa, a really tough task for you. \n\rIt's #bUlu City#k, see? It was bustling, once. TOO bustling. Everyone was all 'expand, expand, expand' and they, like, didn't care what they did to nature...
0.1: And that, like, ended up being their downfall. Their trash came to life, turning into these monster things that chased people out of their homes and went 'wooo, wooo, wooo'. Awful stuff, man.
0.2: An old pal of mine, #b#p9270044##k, leads an Ulu patrol squad. You want to help him get people's homes back and stuff?

yes.0: Woo, great. But first, you have to prove you can handle the task, man. I don't to be all responsible for your death. You've got to, like, hunt some monsters before I send you to #b#p9270044##k.
yes.1: Hunt #b50 #o9420514#s#k, #b50 #o9420515#s#k and #b30 #o9420516#s#k. They appear in #bUlu City#k. Bring me #b50 #t4000429#s#k, #b50 #t4000430#s#k and #b50 #t4000431#s#k to #b#p9270044##k. My friend'll probably want to reward you for clearing out some of those monsters.

no.0: No, I get it, man. Saving a city ain't for everyone. Some folks just can't handle the pressure.

1.0: I saw you out there, kicking some serious monster behind. We can work together, you and me.

yes.0: You tell me when you're ready to show these filthy pieces of garbage where the rubbish bin is.

item.0: Maybe you don't have what it takes to be a savior. Go hunt the rest of the monsters and collect the required items, man.

mob.0: Maybe you don't have what it takes to be a savior. Go hunt the rest of the monsters and collect the required items, man.
